title: MulTTiPop: A Multitrack Transcription Dataset for Pop Music
abstract: arXiv:2607.08756v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present MulTTiPop, a dataset of pop music segments and their associated multitrack MIDI recordings for the evaluation of automatic music transcription models. MulTTiPop contains 572 segments of popular music totaling 3.5 hours of audio, and contains songs from diverse genres and decades from the 1930s to 2000s. To collect this dataset, we perform metadata-based matching on song segments from the Lakh MIDI and TheoryTab datasets, manually identify an anchor beat between the audio and MIDI, then use beat tracking on the audio and warp the MIDI to match its tempo and timing. We evaluate state-of-the-art automatic music transcription models on MulTTiPop and find substantial room for improvement, with the best model achieving 29% Onset F1. More details and sound examples of MulTTiPop are available at https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop.

translated_title: MulTTiPop：一个用于流行音乐的多轨转录数据集
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.08756v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们介绍了MulTTiPop，一个包含流行音乐片段及其关联多轨MIDI录音的数据集，用于评估自动音乐转录模型。MulTTiPop包含572个流行音乐片段，总计3.5小时的音频，涵盖了从1930年代到2000年代的不同流派和年代。为了收集该数据集，我们对Lakh MIDI和TheoryTab数据集中的歌曲片段进行基于元数据的匹配，手动识别音频和MIDI之间的锚定节拍，然后使用音频节拍跟踪并调整MIDI以匹配其速度和时序。我们在MulTTiPop上评估了最先进的自动音乐转录模型，发现仍有很大的改进空间，最佳模型仅达到29%的起始点F1分数。有关MulTTiPop的更多详细信息和音频示例，请访问https://gclef-cmu.edu/multtipop。
tldr: 本文提出了MulTTiPop，一个包含572个流行音乐片段的多轨MIDI数据集，用于评估自动音乐转录，并发现现有最佳模型性能仍有显著提升空间。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MulTTiPop, a multitrack MIDI dataset of 572 pop music segments for evaluating automatic music transcription, revealing significant room for improvement in current state-of-the-art models.
